skills.name: Characteristics of matter in the different states

note.text:
Matter is made of tiny particles. The states differ in how the particles are arranged and how they move:
• Solid: particles packed close in a regular pattern; they only vibrate. A solid has a fixed shape and a fixed volume, and cannot be compressed.
• Liquid: particles close together but able to slide past one another. A liquid has a fixed volume but takes the shape of its container; it is hardly compressible and it flows.
• Gas: particles far apart, moving fast in all directions. A gas has no fixed shape and no fixed volume: it fills its container, and it is easy to compress.
Diffusion (the spreading of a smell through a room) shows that gas particles move.

worked_example.problem: Explain why {s} can be squeezed into a small cylinder, but water in a syringe cannot be squeezed.
steps: In a gas the particles are far apart, with a lot of space between them: they can be pushed closer.
In a liquid the particles already touch: there is almost no space, so it is hardly compressible.
worked_example.answer: Gas particles are far apart; liquid particles are close together.

cards.idea: A solid has a fixed shape and volume; a liquid has a fixed volume but no fixed shape; a gas has neither.
example: Water takes the shape of the cup.

cards.idea: Particles: close and vibrating in a solid; close and sliding in a liquid; far apart and fast in a gas.
Gases are easy to compress; liquids and solids are not.
example: Air in a bicycle pump can be squeezed.
Water in a closed syringe cannot.

pick.q: Why is it easy to pump air into a tyre?
pick.r: Gas particles have spaces between them.
pick.y: There is space between gas particles, so gas compresses.

pick.q: The smell of fried plantains reaches the whole house. What does this show?
pick.r: Gas particles move and spread out (diffusion).
pick.y: Spreading of a gas is diffusion.

pick.q: Why does a stone keep its shape?
pick.r: Its particles are held in fixed places.
pick.y: In a solid the particles stay in a fixed pattern.

A gas is easy to compress.

wrong.text: A liquid has no fixed volume.
wrong.explain: A liquid has a fixed volume; only its shape changes.

wrong.text: Solid particles move freely in all directions.
